'''Rocket engines''' were a form of propulsion.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] were equipped with high-boost rocket [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Maintenance pod]]s were equipped with small rocket engines to allow them to maneuver in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TDC" />
